stages.instruction: Before subject work agree coarse Task phases with the independent reviewer. Publish genuine already-obtained intake/preparation facts in declared framing.facts with exact provenance, distinguishing reported symptoms from observed facts. Do not invent missing prerequisites or perform substantive reproduction/experiments here. Design only imminent reproduction: goal, result requirements, acceptance criteria, actual environment/source/input identity, methods, capture completeness, bounds and preservation.

Use actual method inputs, runtime/source identity and stage receipts. Runtime records real BoundExecution digests; never fabricate future methods or hashes.
sections.reproduction_plan: State imminent reproduction goal, result requirements, acceptance criteria, actual intake facts and reported symptoms, exact environment/runtime/source/input identity, read-only methods, observations needed to distinguish reproduced/not-reproduced, capture completeness, limits and preservation.

stages.instruction: Only after actual experiment results are independently accepted, design imminent causal-report production: draft the causal argument, obtain real confirmation and reconcile this same unaccepted report. Define goal, required result, acceptance criteria, reproducible inference and counterexample methods, actual confirmation procedures/claim selectors, completeness and permitted uncertainty. Use actual accepted evidence; never invent future causes, commands, measurements or hashes.

sections.confirmation_plan: Define exact existing controlled/read-only discriminating methods and claim selectors from accepted actual facts, expected confirming/refuting observations, input selectors, repeated checks, limits and permitted uncertainty. Do not invent a future cause, available command, measurement or hash. Any necessary write belongs to separately authorized work.

stages.instruction: Independently review imminent analytical/confirmation plans against actual accepted facts for executability, completeness and unambiguity. Check traceable causal claim selectors, alternatives and independent discriminating evidence, exact read-only methods, required capture, reconciliation and explicit uncertainty criteria. Decide criteria only for root_cause_analysis and synthesis execution in this same report phase. Reject design to analysis_planning.

stages.instruction: Produce a draft causal report under accepted current analysis/confirmation plans using independently accepted actual intake, reproduction and experiment records. Link claim IDs to exact receipts and environment/source/input identity, falsifiable alternatives, reproducible causal inference summaries, assumptions and limitations. Distinguish correlation from causation. Do not expose private chain-of-thought, rewrite accepted records or execute recommendations. The report is not accepted before actual confirmation, synthesis and independent review.

sections.root_cause: For each current causal claim ID state its status, exact symptoms/facts/reproduction/experiment/confirmation receipts and environment/source/input identities, causal inference summary, assumptions, rejected alternatives and limitations. Correlation or report editing does not prove causation; reconcile actual counterevidence. Inconclusive is acceptable only under explicit accepted Task criteria.
sections.recommendations: Propose actions only from current supported causal conclusions and exact evidence, expected effect, risks and subsequent verification. Revise recommendations after confirmation/refutation. Never execute a repair or optimization automatically.

stages.instruction: Reconcile root_cause and recommendations in this same unaccepted report using actual confirmation.confirmation and accepted intake/reproduction/experiment receipts. Update refuted or unresolved claim IDs, causal status, rejected alternatives, assumptions, limitations and affected recommendations consistently. Preserve accepted facts. Report editing cannot prove an unsupported cause; a negative diagnosis can be a correct report, while missing required coverage is not completion. Inconclusive acceptance requires explicit agreed criteria; never invent waivers or execute repairs.

Distinguish report quality from a positive causal verdict; uncertainty needs explicit agreed criteria.
